fee.name: Taiwan carbon fee (碳費)
fee.legalBasis: Climate Change Response Act; Regulations Governing the Collection of Carbon Fees (碳費收費辦法), Arts 3, 5 and 6 (MOENV, issued 2024-08-29, amended 2026-09-01)
fee.exemptBasis: high carbon leakage risk with an approved self-reduction plan: emission adjustment factor 0.2 for the first period (Art 6), K = 0 for high-leakage entities (Art 5); exempted share (1 − 0.2) counted as a rebate (draft Art 8(1)(b)(iii); Annex I 5(d))

refPriceNote: €82.32 is the Q3 2026 CBAM certificate price, used here as an illustrative stand-in: the draft's reference price is the yearly average of the CBAM certificate prices of the year of import (draft Art 6(3)), which for 2026 is not yet known (Q4 not published on 2026-10-16).

sources.what: CBAM Art 9 draft implementing regulation (formulae Annex I eq. 1-17, Art 5, Art 6, Art 8, Art 9, Art 16, Annex II-IV)
Status: working draft 13 May 2026, feedback 13 May-10 June 2026, not adopted as of 12 Oct 2026
Taiwan carbon fee regulation: fee = (emissions − K) × adjustment factor × rate; K 25,000 t (0 for high leakage); factor 0.2 / 0.4 / 0.6
First payment (May 2026, 2025 emissions): NT$4.97 bn; standard NT$300/t; preferential NT$50 and NT$100; 29 steel plants NT$400 m
